title: Grouped-Query Attention
signature: def grouped_query_attention(q: np.ndarray, k: np.ndarray, v: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray
hints: With g = n_q // n_kv, query head h reads K/V head h // g. Consecutive query heads share a K/V head.
np.repeat(k, g, axis=1) gives exactly that layout. np.tile gives a different one (h % n_kv).
Mask positions j > i with -inf before a max-shifted softmax. The diagonal stays visible.
